2608.27729.title: Below the Noise Floor: Bimodal Seed Collapse and Distinct Failure Modes in Small-Model Knowledge Distillation
2608.27729.paper_summary: Function routing -- selecting the correct API call from a fixed catalog given a natural-language request -- is a deployment problem where small students are attractive but knowledge distillation gains are typically reported single-seed, at scales where seed variance is unknown. On a 740-instance healthcare API routing task with a 1.5B Qwen student and a 20B teacher, we compare eight KD variants against supervised cross-entropy, using three to six seeds for key configurations. We find: (i) per-seed standard deviation ranges from 2.8 to 48.7 percentage points, swallowing every claimed KD gain below five points; (ii) three of seven KD variants exhibit bimodal collapse, with at least one in three to five seeds falling below 55% accuracy while the others train normally, and a fourth showing elevated variance; (iii) collapse has distinct modes -- wrong-function selection for ce_kd and ce_paraphrase, and a previously undocumented output-truncation mode for reasoning_kd, where the model emits reasoning but terminates before producing a function name (0.9% accuracy); (iv) only progressive_kd and rank_kd avoid collapse across observed seeds, with sigma <= 3.9 pp; (v) a naive cross-split +3.78 pp gain from input enrichment reverses to -2.70 pp under controlled within-split multi-seed re-testing. Single-seed evaluation is therefore unable to detect central failure modes in small-model KD.
2608.27729.paper_summary_zh: 功能路由——根據自然語言請求從固定目錄中選擇正確的API調用——是一個部署問題，其中小型學生具有吸引力，但知識蒸餾的增益通常報告為單種子，在種子變異性未知的規模下。在一個740實例的醫療API路由任務中，使用1.5B的Qwen學生和20B的教師，我們比較了八種KD變體與監督交叉熵，對於關鍵配置使用三到六個種子。我們發現：(i) 每個種子的標準差範圍從2.8到48.7個百分點，吞噬了每個聲稱的KD增益低於五個百分點；(ii) 七種KD變體中有三種表現出雙峰崩潰，至少有三到五個種子中的一個低於55%的準確率，而其他的正常訓練，第四種顯示出較高的變異性；(iii) 崩潰有明顯的模式——ce_kd和ce_paraphrase的錯誤功能選擇，以及一種先前未記錄的推理_kd的輸出截斷模式，其中模型發出推理但在產生函數名稱之前終止（0.9%準確率）；(iv) 只有progressive_kd和rank_kd在觀察到的種子中避免崩潰，sigma <= 3.9 pp；(v) 一個天真的交叉拆分+3.78 pp的增益來自輸入豐富化，在受控的內部分裂多種子重新測試下反轉為-2.70 pp。因此，單種子評估無法檢測小型模型KD中的中心失效模式。
